title: fix remove handler cause ByteToMessageDecoder out disorder

timeline.message: fix remove handler cause ByteToMessageDecoder out disorder
timeline.author: switchYello

timeline.body:
Motivation:

Data flowing in from the decoder flows out in sequence，Whether decoder removed or not.

Modification:

fire data in out and clear out when hander removed
before call method handlerRemoved(ctx)

Result:

Fixes #9668 .
Can one of the admins verify this patch?
nit: add whitespace after each `,`

You will need to call `release()` on each of the `ByteBuf` instances... Alternative you could change your decoder to just do:

```
out.add(in.readByte());
```

And then assert the returned `byte`.
@switchYello ping me once you addressed the comments
